title: A kernel proof of the De Cock-De Moor Lyapunov identity
summary: We prove the rank-one Lyapunov spectral identity recorded as Problem 9.1 in the 2004 collection of unsolved problems in mathematical systems and control theory. Let $P,Q,R$ solve the coupled discrete Lyapunov and Sylvester equations associated with $A$ and its rank-one update $A_2=A+vw^\top$. When the displayed inverses exist, we show that $P^{-1}RQ^{-1}R^\top$ and $(I+PQ)^{-1}$ have the same characteristic polynomial.
